judge.notes: 66GB bf16. Fits ONE A100-80GB (util 0.92). vLLM 0.22.1 REQUIRES --mm-encoder-attn-backend TORCH_SDPA on every GPU generation (encoder passes CPU cu_seqlens to flash-attn varlen kernels). First run per GPU arch pays ~25min FlashInfer CUTLASS MoE JIT, cached in ~/.cache/flashinfer.

qwen-omni.notes: Served model name is qwen-omni, NOT qwen-omni-7b.

phi4mm.notes: Speech LoRA (rank 320) lives in the snapshot's speech-lora/ dir. Every request MUST target model name 'speech' (the LoRA adapter) - the base name is accepted but silently skips the LoRA.

kimi-audio.notes: NEVER plain `vllm serve`. Serve via the repo wrapper benchmarking/mmau_pro/run19/serve_kimi.py with --chat-template benchmarking/mmau_pro/run19/template_kimi_audio_epf.jinja.
